settings.editor: For laboratory standards and research purposes only.
Explore ONYX research materials with batch level analytical documentation and laboratory focused specifications.
All ONYX materials are supplied exclusively for legitimate laboratory and scientific research. They are not intended for human or veterinary use, diagnosis, treatment, or therapeutic application.
Explore laboratory research materials supported by batch-level analytical testing and documentation. ONYX products are supplied exclusively for legitimate laboratory and scientific research.

Peptide research covers a broad range of laboratory and analytical applications. ONYX provides research materials for scientific investigations involving peptide identity, composition, analytical characteristics and laboratory methodologies.

settings.editor: Research supporting analytical procedures and laboratory testing workflows.

Every ONYX Research batch is independently verified by third-party laboratories using HPLC and mass spectrometry, with a reported purity of at least 99%. A certificate of analysis accompanies each product line, documenting identity, purity and batch-specific testing data.
